sloka: यद्यहं तस्य पृष्ठेन तदा यायामनिन्दिता।नाद्यैवमनुशोचेयं भर्तुरङ्कगता सती ।। ६.९३.५५ ।।
transliteration: yadyahaṁ tasya pṛṣṭhena tadā yāyāmaninditā।nādyaivamanuśoceyaṁ bharturaṅkagatā satī ।। 6.93.55 ।।

translations.english: 'I am a foolish woman. I did not follow Hanuman's advice and had I left mounted on his back, no doubt I would be on my husband 's lap. I did not think in this way'.
